description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between the value ‘m’ and Mean Average Precision at 10 (MAP@10) for two sampling strategies. The horizontal axis, labeled “m”, displays categories numbered 6 through 10 in ascending order, with a linear scale. The vertical axis, labeled “MAP@10 m”, represents the value of MAP@10, ranging from 23.0 to 27.0 with a linear scale and tick marks at 0.5 intervals.  For each value of ‘m’, there are two bars representing the “Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy” in purple and the “Uniform Sampling Strategy” in yellow. The purple bars representing the Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy have heights of approximately 26.2, 26.5, 26.7, 26.8, and 26.9 for m values of 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 respectively. The yellow bars representing the Uniform Sampling Strategy have heights of approximately 24.3, 24.6, 24.9, 25.2, and 25.6 for m values of 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 respectively. The bars are grouped by ‘m’ value, with the Fine-to-Coarse Sampling Strategy bar appearing to the left of the Uniform Sampling Strategy bar for each ‘m’ value. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
